snippet.title: OFFICIAL TRAILER: Sylva - Curse of the Demon Woods
snippet.description:
Check the game out on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232070/Sylva__Curse_of_the_Demon_Woods/

Explore a world of darkness and mystery in this new videogame, featuring Metroidvania and Soulslike elements. Fight and defeat powerful monsters in a magical, interconnected map filled with the screams and blood of your enemies. Repent your sins as a nameless knight, slay fiends and decide who is your friend and who is your foe. Find the ultimate purpose of your sin-riddled life in swamps, demonic forests, forgotten mausoleums and suspicious churches. Of course, don't forget to relax with a bit of fishing!
